name: Usuishi Sayuri
source:
A patient who has been treated by the protagonist for “hypersexuality” several times.

She is a celebrity married woman who is being played with by the protagonist, instead of curing her illness which is getting worse and worse.

Her husband is the president of an IT company, but he is not a good sex partner and is constantly frustrated due to his fatigue.

[From [url=https://www.lune-soft.jp/game/5386]official site[/url]]
